name: Takeo (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Takeo city emblem in white: a winged device above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Takeo, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 2006.

features.role: Takeo city emblem — a winged device above a ring
